verdict.rationale: VLP Law Group is a professional legal-services firm offering fintech regulatory, venture, IP, privacy, and employment counsel, not a software or automation platform. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation capability: the 'high-efficiency workflow' mention describes its practice model, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
